change.after: "returns results of the most recent cached probe"

consequence.statement: The command still works, but it returns cached results from the most recent probe instead of running a synchronous one. The option is hidden and will be removed in a future release.

assertion.statement: The `cilium-health status --probe` option no longer runs a synchronous probe; it is hidden and returns the most recent cached probe results, and it will be removed in a future release.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Use of `cilium-health status --probe` is a manual or scripted CLI invocation. No manifest, values or ConfigMap predicate can show it.
